source: Diode analytic Lambert W: I=(n*VT/R)*W((R*IS/nVT)*exp((V+R*IS)/nVT))-IS. NPN forward-active Ebers-Moll: IS*(exp(Vbe/VT)-1)=BF*(5-Vbe)/100k, Vce=5-Ic*500, IS=1e-15 BF=100 VAF=infinity. VT=(k/q)*300.15 K. MOS square law: beta*(Vov*Vds-Vds^2/2) or beta*Vov^2/2, times (1+lambda*Vds), beta=200u*10, Vov=2. CMOS Vm=(sqrt(beta_n)*Vtn+sqrt(beta_p)*(5-|Vtp|))/(sqrt(beta_n)+sqrt(beta_p)); lambda=0 ideal reference. Equations/defaults: https://ngspice.sourceforge.io/docs/ngspice-46-manual.pdf Additional references: diode RS and zener use independent bisection of Shockley+IBV*exp(-(Vd+BV)/nVT) with total series resistance; ramp currents use analytic I(V)+dQ(V)/dV*dV/dt. Gummel-Poon qb=q1*(1+sqrt(1+4*If/IKF))/2 with q1=1/(1-Vbc/VAF-Vbe/VAR). MOS body effect Vt=VTO+GAMMA*(sqrt(PHI-Vbs)-sqrt(PHI)). BJT depletion charge uses SPICE defaults VJE=VJC=0.75, MJE=MJC=0.33, FC=0.5, with linear capacitance continuation above FC*VJ.
